files.content:
# Default Credentials Payloads

# Common username:password combinations
admin:admin
admin:password
administrator:administrator
root:root
root:toor
root:password
test:test
guest:guest
user:user
demo:demo

# Database default credentials
root:
admin:
sa:
postgres:postgres
mysql:mysql
oracle:oracle

# Application defaults
admin:admin123
admin:Admin123
administrator:password
webadmin:webadmin
sysadmin:sysadmin

# IoT/Network device defaults
admin:1234
admin:12345
admin:123456
root:12345
ubnt:ubnt
cisco:cisco

# Format variations
username: admin / password: (blank)
username: root / password: (blank)
username: administrator / password: administrator
